title: Domain Mapping And Git History Audit

task_results.title: Re-check verified domains and Cloud Run mapping
task_results.message: gcloud domains list-user-verified artik beachgo.net sonucunu dondu. Cloud Run domain mapping api.beachgo.net mevcut ve route beachrehberi-api'ye bagli.

task_results.title: Extract exact DNS target and SSL state
task_results.message: Domain mapping status.resourceRecords uzerinden exact kayit api CNAME ghs.googlehosted.com. olarak dogrulandi. Public DNS'te kayit henuz yok; SSL durumu CertificatePending.

task_results.title: Git history secret pattern audit
task_results.message: git log -S taramasinda BEACGO_DB_CONN ve eski development JWT secret pattern'i gecmis commitlerde goruldu. History rewrite/force-push onayi olmadigi icin sadece audit kaydi tutuldu.

verification_results.name: gcloud-domain-mapping-describe
verification_results.message: Mapping status.resourceRecords icinde api CNAME ghs.googlehosted.com. ve condition olarak CertificatePending goruldu.

verification_results.name: public-dns-nslookup-api-beachgo-net
verification_results.message: Public DNS su an NXDOMAIN dondu; registrar tarafinda CNAME kaydi henuz yok.

verification_results.name: git-history-secret-patterns
verification_results.message: BEACHGO_DB_CONN pattern'i birden fazla gecmis committe bulundu. Rewrite uygulanmadi.
